description: The bar chart illustrates the "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment." The horizontal axis displays the categories of models evaluated, ordered from left to right as "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," with the text labels slightly tilted. The vertical axis represents the value, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," using a linear scale that ranges from 0 to 400 with tick marks and corresponding horizontal dashed gridlines at regular intervals of 50. A legend in the top left corner indicates that the dark green color corresponds to "Our Joint Framework," while light blue corresponds to "LLM Models." There are five vertical bars, each outlined in black and annotated with its exact numerical value in bold text directly above it. The first bar, "Our Joint Framework," is dark green and represents the shortest runtime at 77 seconds. The remaining four bars are light blue: "ChatGPT" has a value of 190, "DeepSeek" is the tallest bar with a value of 365, "LLaMA" has a value of 172, and "Claude" has a value of 243. The bars are not sorted alphabetically or by numerical value, but visual emphasis is placed on "Our Joint Framework" through its distinct dark green color, contrasting with the uniform light blue of the other models.
